hi.intro: एक नाम सुनिए जो योद्धाओं की कतारों के बीच से कटता है। देखिए, अर्जुन कैसे महान् सेनापतियों को एक ब्रह्मांडीय मुख के भीतर रखता है।
hi.meaning: अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः सर्वे सहैव अवनिपालसङ्घैः । भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथाऽसौ सह अस्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः ॥
hi.notice: एक नाम देखिए, सूतपुत्रः, यानी कर्ण। अर्जुन उसे उन लोगों में रखता है जो पहले से ही मुखों में जा रहे हैं।

issues: meaning_changed: "Notice one name, sūtaputraḥ, the charioteer's son. It is Karna, the greatest rival, and Arjuna places him among those already rushing into the mouths, showing that the war is no longer a contest between equals." (The notice claims the war is 'no longer a contest between equals,' which introduces a subjective interpretation not present in the verse's literal meaning of warriors rushing into Krishna's cosmic mouths. The verse simply lists the warriors; it does not frame the war as a 'contest between equals' that has been broken.)

borrowed: "Arjuna sees them caught between the teeth with crushed heads, and his fear deepens." (The 'next' description is borrowed from verse 27, which explicitly describes the warriors being caught between the teeth with crushed heads. This verse (26) only mentions the warriors rushing into the mouths, not them being caught with crushed heads.)
